title: Felix and the Current
author: Jonah Underhill
blurb: Casper Galloway, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, has spent fifteen years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
